sentences.text: The parents' room stayed below 18.0 °C, reaching a low of 16.8 °C at 05:50.
The bathroom also registered a low of 17.3 °C at 03:40, and the office temperature was 17.9 °C at 05:20.
Since WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons, you might want to check the heating system.
